failure.symptom: Windows installer build intermittently returned ISCC_EXIT_1 / output lock behavior while an Inno Setup compiler child continued writing the target artifact.
failure.impact: Could cause false build failure, blind rerun risk, or hashing an incomplete/locked installer.
failure.rootCause: Build orchestration did not serialize payload/installer writers and did not allow enough time for the compiler/output file to become exclusively readable and size-stable.

prevention: Shared exclusive windows-150-build.lock is required by both payload and installer build scripts.
Installer waits up to 120 seconds for any previous output writer to release before deleting the prior artifact.
After compiler return, installer waits up to 120 seconds for exclusive read access.
Artifact size must remain identical across three samples before hashing/evidence promotion.
No artifact is promoted from a locked or unstable output.

regression.repeatedArtifactIdentity: Same exact installer SHA-256 as the preceding complete diagnostic compile.
